segments.name: convenient nutrition
segments.description: Single consolidated segment supplying protein-based consumer goods, mainly ready-to-drink protein shakes and powders, to consumers through club, retail and online channels.
segments.evidence: We have a single operating and reportable segment, with our principal products being protein-based consumer goods.

revenueModel.text: Club, food, drug and mass retailers, eCommerce, specialty, convenience stores and distributors pay the company for protein shakes and powders.
revenueModel.evidence: Our customers are predominantly club stores, FDM retailers, online retailers, specialty retailers, convenience stores and distributors.

changes.text: In fiscal 2023 the company approved a plan to discontinue the PowerBar business in North America.
changes.evidence: In August 2023, the Company approved a plan to discontinue the PowerBar business in North America .
